parts.v: **New in-game admin panel.** Open it with /dirk_multichar or the new cog on the character list to reach the Basic, Scene, Backstories, Spawn Locations, States and VIP Roles tabs.
**Backstory system rebuilt.** Create and manage backstories in-game across General, Access, Items and Scenes tabs, with optional locked or Discord-role-only access.
**Scene tab.** Drag to reorder character positions, set their animations, and place positions or the customisation spot by walking there in-game (E to confirm, Backspace to cancel).
**Spawn Locations tab.** Add spawns with an icon picker and in-game group and rank pickers, with no IDs to type by hand.
**States tab.** Edit character states (icon, colour, message, or switch one off) and search online players to apply a state from the same tab.
**All settings now live in the panel.** The old Lua settings files are gone, and camera views, default items and character states can now be edited there too.
**Changes apply live.** Saving in the panel takes effect straight away with no restart, including the slot count on the character screen.
**Toggles moved to their tabs.** The Spawn Selector toggle now lives in Spawn Locations, and VIP Roles has a Use ESX Character Slots Table toggle.
**Weather and time follow your server.** The character scene shows whatever your own weather and time sync is running.
**Refreshed and fully translatable.** Every screen is restyled to match our other scripts, and every label, tooltip and message can now be translated.
**Locked VIP slots show "VIP Slot".** They previously showed a blank label on the character list.
**Appearance menu opens reliably on QBX.** New characters go straight into illenium-appearance, with a seamless camera handover.
**/dirk_multichar no longer gets stuck loading.** It could sit on "Settings UI is still loading"; it now opens normally.
**vms_housing support.** Player housing from vms_housing is now displayed.
**Darker theme.** Buttons and backgrounds are darker to better match our other scripts.
**Lifestyles system revamped.** A cleaner look, and lifestyles are now easier to create and manage from the lifestyles settings file.
**ESX character slots for VIP.** VIP slots can now use the existing character slots table from es_extended.
**Option to disable character deletion.**
**Clothing menus now handled by dirk_lib.** Appearance menu support lives in one place, making it simpler to add more.
**Better car and house detection.** Players' cars and houses are found more reliably, including qs-housing.
**Characters show on QBX.** Fixed qbx_core servers showing no characters because the license2 identifier wasn't picked up.
**Characters display with every major clothing script.** This includes illenium-appearance and rcore_clothing.
**Player HUDs now show after loading in.** Fixed a load event issue that could stop HUDs appearing.
